evals.prompt: Configure notifications for our CloudWatch alarm using SNS.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill

Prompts upfront for the required parameters (`alarm_name`, `notification_type` [`email`, `sms`, `webhook`, `lambda`, or `sqs`], and `notification_endpoint`) plus optional defaults (`sns_topic_name` and `aws_region`)
Does not create SNS topics or mutate alarms before parameter confirmation

evals.prompt: Check in `ap-south-1` (read-only) whether CloudWatch alarm `prod-rds-high-cpu` exists (`cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms`), list any existing alarms in `ap-south-1`, and lay out the complete encrypted SNS topic + topic policy + `email` subscription (`oncall@example.com`) + `AlarmActions` setup plan without mutating AWS.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill and calls `cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms` in `ap-south-1` via connected AWS MCP tools with zero raw `aws` CLI shell commands

Reports accurately that `prod-rds-high-cpu` does not exist in `ap-south-1` (asking per Step 2 whether to create a new alarm or pick another name) and details the full procedure: `sns:CreateTopic`, `SetTopicAttributes` KMS encryption, `cloudwatch.amazonaws.com` SNS Topic Policy with `aws:SourceAccount`/`aws:SourceArn`, `sns:Subscribe` (`PendingConfirmation` confirmation note!), and `put-metric-alarm` linking `AlarmActions`/`OKActions` with `ActionsEnabled=true`
Makes zero mutating AWS calls

evals.prompt: WARNING CHECK: An engineer encrypted their SNS topic with the default AWS-managed KMS key **`alias/aws/sns`** and wired a CloudWatch Alarm to it, and now the CloudWatch Alarm History shows `Failed to execute action arn:aws:sns:...: KMSAccessDeniedException: null (Service: AWSKMS; ... cloudwatch.amazonaws.com is not authorized to perform: kms:GenerateDataKey)`! Explain why `alias/aws/sns` fails with CloudWatch Alarms and write the exact **Customer Managed KMS Key (CMK)** policy fix!
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill

Identifies the root cause: AWS-managed KMS key `alias/aws/sns` has an immutable default key policy that does NOT grant `cloudwatch.amazonaws.com` permission to generate data keys, causing CloudWatch -> encrypted SNS publishes to fail silently

Provides a **Customer Managed KMS Key (CMK)** JSON policy granting `Principal: { "Service": "cloudwatch.amazonaws.com" }` `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey*` (scoped with `aws:SourceAccount` / `aws:SourceArn`) and notes ensuring the SNS topic policy allows `cloudwatch.amazonaws.com` `sns:Publish`

evals.prompt: Our CloudWatch Alarm transitioned from `OK` to `ALARM` (`StateValue=ALARM`), yet nobody on `sre-alerts@example.com` received an email! Walk through the exact verification steps across `cloudwatch describe-alarms`, `get-alarm-history`, and `sns list-subscriptions-by-topic`.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill

Checks: (1) `ActionsEnabled: true` and exact `AlarmActions` SNS Topic ARN on `describe-alarms`, (2) `describe-alarm-history` (`HistoryItemType=Action`) for KMS or SNS Topic Policy `AccessDenied` publish errors, and (3) `sns list-subscriptions-by-topic` checking whether `SubscriptionArn` is stuck at **`"PendingConfirmation"`** (recipient never clicked the confirmation link!) vs confirmed ARN

evals.prompt: Compare wiring CloudWatch Alarm SNS notifications to Slack / Microsoft Teams / PagerDuty via (1) **AWS Chatbot (`chat.amazonaws.com`)**, (2) **HTTPS Webhook SNS Subscription**, and (3) **SNS -> Lambda formatter**, including HTTPS-only transport and secret webhook token safety.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill

Compares **AWS Chatbot** (native rich CloudWatch Alarm cards + graphs in Slack/Teams with zero custom code or webhook secrets!), **HTTPS `webhook` SNS subscriptions** (direct to PagerDuty Events integration URL over `https://` — never `http://`, handling `SubscriptionConfirmation` handshake + SNS delivery retry policy + DLQ), and **SNS -> Lambda** (custom enrichment storing webhook tokens in **Secrets Manager**, never hardcoded in URLs/env vars)

evals.prompt: Write a hardened **Amazon SNS Topic Access Policy** for `arn:aws:sns:ap-south-1:111122223333:prod-critical-alarms` that allows ONLY CloudWatch Alarms in account `111122223333` to publish, denies non-TLS (`aws:SecureTransport: false`) API/publish/subscribe calls, and restricts `sns:Subscribe` to authorized admins.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill

Grants `cloudwatch.amazonaws.com` `sns:Publish` conditioned on `aws:SourceAccount = "111122223333"` and `ArnLike: { "aws:SourceArn": "arn:aws:cloudwatch:ap-south-1:111122223333:alarm:*" }`, adds an explicit `Deny` when `aws:SecureTransport == "false"`, and avoids wide-open `Principal: "*"` publish/subscribe statements

evals.prompt: WARNING: When adding `--alarm-actions <sns-arn>` to an existing CloudWatch Metric Alarm via `aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm`, what happens if you only pass `--alarm-name` and `--alarm-actions` (or omit `TreatMissingData`, `DatapointsToAlarm`, `Dimensions`, `OKActions`), and how do you update an existing alarm safely without clobbering its threshold settings?
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill

Explains that **`put-metric-alarm` overwrites the entire alarm definition by `AlarmName`** (requiring metric/threshold fields and resetting omitted optional fields like `TreatMissingData`, `DatapointsToAlarm`, `OKActions`, `InsufficientDataActions`!), so you MUST first call `describe-alarms --alarm-names <name>`, copy all existing fields (`MetricName`/`Metrics`, `Namespace`, `Dimensions`, `Statistic`/`ExtendedStatistic`, `Period`, `EvaluationPeriods`, `DatapointsToAlarm`, `Threshold`, `ComparisonOperator`, `TreatMissingData`), merge the new `AlarmActions` + `OKActions`, and re-submit

evals.prompt: An ops team tried subscribing `98765-43210` (missing country code) to an SNS alarm topic for SMS paging in production, and also wants guaranteed capture if a webhook endpoint is down for 2 hours. Cover SMS `E.164` / spending-quota gotchas AND **SNS Subscription Dead-Letter Queues (`RedrivePolicy`)**.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill

Requires strict **E.164 phone format** (e.g., `+12025550199` / `+12065550100`), notes SNS SMS sandbox / monthly account spend quota (`MonthlySpendLimit` defaults to `$1.00` which silently stops SMS paging once exhausted!) and regional regulatory sender ID/DLT rules, and attaches an **SQS Dead-Letter Queue (`RedrivePolicy`)** to critical SNS subscriptions so undeliverable alerts are never silently lost

evals.prompt: During a database maintenance window or upstream VPC outage, 35 individual microservice CloudWatch Alarms all fire SNS emails simultaneously, causing alert fatigue! Show how **CloudWatch Composite Alarms (`PutCompositeAlarm` + `ActionsSuppressor`)** route clean single-page notifications through SNS.
expectations: Activates the setting-up-cloudwatch-alarm-notifications skill

Explains removing direct noisy `AlarmActions` from individual child metric alarms and aggregating boolean logic (`ALARM(a) AND ALARM(b)`) in a **Composite Alarm** (`put-composite-alarm`) with **`ActionsSuppressor`** (e.g., a maintenance-mode or root-cause dependency alarm suppressing downstream symptom pages during `WaitPeriod`/`ExtensionPeriod`) wired to the KMS-encrypted SNS topic

evals.prompt: Query AWS documentation via connected AWS documentation tools to compare invoking an AWS Lambda function **directly as a CloudWatch Alarm Action** (`arn:aws:lambda:...` with `lambda.alarms.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com` resource policy) versus routing **`CloudWatch Alarm -> SNS Topic -> Lambda + Email/Chatbot`**.
expectations: Queries connected AWS documentation MCP tools (`awsknowledge`, `aws-mcp`, or `awsiac`) with zero raw `aws` CLI commands

Contrasts **Direct CloudWatch Alarm Lambda Actions** (simpler 1-to-1 automated remediation/enrichment requiring `lambda:AddPermission` for principal **`lambda.alarms.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com`** with `aws:SourceAccount`/`aws:SourceArn`) against **SNS Topic Fan-Out** (preferred when simultaneously notifying multiple human + automated channels — Email, AWS Chatbot/Slack, PagerDuty HTTPS, SQS, and Lambda — from a single alarm state transition)
